stem: ![](asset:P000426-stem-1)Figure shows a rod of length 20 cm pivoted near an end and which is made to rotate in a horizontal plane with a constant angular speed. A ball of mass m is suspended by a string also of length 20 cm from the other end of the rod. If the angle θ made by the string with the vertical is 30°, find the angular speed of the rotation.

assets.alt: A horizontal arm of length L rotating about a vertical pole with angular speed ω; from its end, a mass m hangs on a string of length L at angle θ to the vertical.
